boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named University of Dayton spaces for studying, gathering, recreation, reflection, and campus events, each supported by a direct University source.

cards.title: Roesch Library
cards.subtitle: Campus library study floors
cards.notes: Choose a floor by the kind of work you need: Roesch designates noise levels by floor, with the sixth floor reserved for silent study.
cards.short_summary: A study building with distinct noise-level zones.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries says students can find open tables or reserve rooms and that the sixth floor is reserved for silent study.
cards.access_notes: A UD ID is used to enter Roesch Library in the evening; room reservations require a UD email address.

cards.title: Gathering Place
cards.subtitle: Roesch Library, second floor
cards.notes: Set up at a table for active work or coordinate with a group; this open second-floor area is normally arranged as flexible study space.
cards.short_summary: A flexible open study area in Roesch Library.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries identifies the Gathering Place as a second-floor open area typically set up for active, flexible study and available for event reservations.
cards.access_notes: Located on Roesch Library's second floor; event use may be reserved.

cards.title: Cameron Corner
cards.subtitle: Roesch Library leisure-reading space
cards.notes: Take a reading break with a leisure title, then return to coursework; the library’s floor map lists Cameron Corner among its dedicated spaces.
cards.short_summary: A named leisure-reading stop within the library.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries' Roesch floor maps list Cameron Corner as a library space alongside study rooms and the Roesch Retreat.
cards.access_notes: Check the current floor map or ask library staff for its exact location.

cards.title: Roesch Retreat
cards.subtitle: Roesch Library quiet-space option
cards.notes: Use this named library space when a quieter reset fits between tasks; confirm the floor and current availability before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A named Roesch Library retreat space.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries' Roesch floor maps list the Roesch Retreat among the library's spaces and features.
cards.access_notes: Consult the library floor maps for location and current building access information.

cards.title: Kennedy Union
cards.subtitle: Student involvement, meeting, dining, and study hub
cards.notes: Use KU as a practical meeting point: it combines study and dining areas with meeting rooms and the Center for Student Involvement.
cards.short_summary: A multi-use campus hub for meetings and downtime.
cards.evidence_claim: The University says Kennedy Union includes spaces for studying, relaxing, dining and fun and houses the Center for Student Involvement.
cards.access_notes: Meeting rooms and event spaces may be scheduled; check the union for current availability.

cards.title: The Hangar
cards.subtitle: Kennedy Union recreation lounge
cards.notes: Meet up for a casual break in this KU lounge, where seating, bowling lanes, and pool tables give groups several ways to spend time.
cards.short_summary: A Kennedy Union lounge with games and seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The University describes The Hangar as a casual space with comfortable seating, bowling lanes and pool tables.
cards.access_notes: Located in Kennedy Union; verify lane, table, and event availability on arrival.

cards.title: Boll Theatre
cards.subtitle: Kennedy Union performance and event venue
cards.notes: Check the event calendar for a performance, speaker, or campus gathering; Boll Theatre is a named venue serving both UD and the Dayton community.
cards.evidence_claim: The University identifies Boll Theatre as a 371-seat performance and event venue for the University of Dayton and Dayton community.
cards.access_notes: Entry and availability depend on the scheduled event.

cards.title: RecPlex
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation at 2 Evanston Ave.
cards.notes: Plan an active break around the indoor track, pool, courts, climbing wall, or fitness studios, and bring the identification required for entry.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Recreation lists the RecPlex's indoor track, eight-lane pool, gyms, rock wall, fitness studios, and other recreation amenities.
cards.access_notes: Campus Recreation states that members must present a valid University ID or membership card; access may require membership.

cards.title: Stuart Field
cards.subtitle: Outdoor recreation field
cards.notes: Bring a group for a casual game when the field is open; it is also used for sport clubs and intramural games, so check for reservations.
cards.short_summary: A large turf field for organized and informal play.
cards.evidence_claim: The University says Stuart Field hosts most sport club and intramural games and can be used for an impromptu game when not in use.
cards.source_title: Athletics and Recreation | University of Dayton
cards.access_notes: Campus Recreation lists regular hours as dawn to dusk weekdays and 9 a.m. to dusk weekends; reserved events can restrict availability.

cards.title: Chapel of the Immaculate Conception
cards.subtitle: Campus prayer and reflection space
cards.notes: Step in for a quiet moment of prayer or reflection between classes, and consult Campus Ministry for worship times or special observances.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus chapel for reflection and worship.
cards.evidence_claim: The University invites people to seek out the chapel for quiet prayer between classes and describes it as the heart of the UD community since 1869.
cards.source_title: Chapel of the Immaculate Conception | University of Dayton
cards.access_notes: The university invites visitors for quiet prayer; worship schedules and special access can change.
